badge.zh: 字节跳动 · 视频生成

summary.en: Seedance 2.5 adds a video-generation lane to the Floatboat ecosystem matrix.
summary.zh: Seedance 2.5 为 Floatboat 生态矩阵增加视频生成路径。

title.en: Seedance turns a project brief into a video workflow.
title.zh: Seedance 把项目简报连接到视频生成工作流。

description.en: Seedance 2.5 is the video-generation entry in the broader ecosystem matrix. Its value is not another chat answer, but a media deliverable shaped by the surrounding brief and review cycle.
description.zh: Seedance 2.5 是更广泛生态矩阵中的视频生成模型。它的价值不是再给一段聊天回答，而是根据项目简报和审阅流程生成媒体交付物。

prompts.en: Turn this storyboard into a video
Create variations from this campaign brief
prompts.zh: 根据营销简报生成多个版本

title.en: One named model, one clear output type.
title.zh: 一个明确型号，一种清晰输出。

description.en: Unlike the text-model pages, this page is about producing and reviewing video assets.
description.zh: 不同于文本模型页面，本页关注视频资产的生成与审阅。

description.en: Video generation from a creative brief, scene plan, or storyboard.
description.zh: 根据创意简报、场景规划或分镜生成视频。

title.en: Brief, generate, then review against intent.
title.zh: 先明确简报，再生成，并按创作意图审阅。

description.en: Specify subject, motion, framing, duration, and visual constraints.
description.zh: 明确主体、运动、构图、时长与视觉约束。

description.en: Create alternatives from the same approved brief instead of rewriting context each time.
description.zh: 基于同一份已确认简报生成备选，不必每次重写上下文。

description.en: Compare motion, continuity, and brand fit before selecting a deliverable.
description.zh: 在确定交付物前比较运动效果、连续性与品牌适配度。

answer.en: No. Seedance 2.5 is listed for video generation; the expected output is a media asset, not a general-purpose text response.
answer.zh: 不是。Seedance 2.5 的定位是视频生成，预期输出是媒体资产，而非通用文本回答。

question.en: Is it in the current client picker?
question.zh: 它在当前客户端模型选择器中吗？

answer.en: It appears in the wider platform and ecosystem matrix, not in the supplied current picker list.
answer.zh: 它属于更广泛的平台与生态矩阵，不在现有客户端选择器清单中。

title.en: Move from prompt to reviewed video asset.
title.zh: 从提示词走向经过审阅的视频资产。

description.en: Use Seedance when the deliverable must move, not when another paragraph will do.
description.zh: 当交付物必须是动态画面，而不是另一段文字时，使用 Seedance。
